children: Uber Technologies, a 10% Owner, reported a direct sale of 29,369,611 shares of Aurora Class A common stock on September 15, 2026. The shares were sold at $6.205 per share in a block sale to a financial institution. The total sale amount was $182,238,436. Following the reported transaction, the Reporting Person directly owned 157,103,800 Class A common shares. The transaction was reported on a Schedule 13D/A filed by the Reporting Person on September 17, 2026.
